content.title: Creekside Park Playground Renovation
content.summary: The City of Arvada has completed a renovation of the Creekside Park playground, which opened in August 2023 as part of the 'Taking Lasting Care' program. The new wildlife-themed playground features various play structures, including slides, climbing walls, and a swing set designed for multiple age groups, all developed with community input through the Speak Up Arvada initiative.
content.body:
![a new wildlife-themed park playground featuring slides, a teeter totter, and climbing net](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=2047 "a new wildlife-themed park playground featuring slides, a teeter totter, and climbing net")

As part of the City of Arvada's ['Taking Lasting Care' program](/860), the Parks and Urban Design team renovated the playground at Creekside Park, located at 5897 Pierce St. in Arvada along the Ralston Creek Trail.

[The new playground at Creekside Park](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Cvxv5V2NgN7/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igshid=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==) opened to the public in August of 2023. The playground's wildlife theme and equipment were chosen with input received from the community through a [Speak Up Arvada](https://speakup.arvada.org/) project.

The wildlife-themed playground features include:

- Custom play structure featuring five slides, climbing walls, play panels, and shade canopy
- Curved balance beam, turtle spinner, clown fish climber, dragonfly teeter totter, and net climber
- Swing set suitable for multiple age groups and abilities, including an expression swing that allows adults and children to swing together

## Project Timeline

- **Fall of 2022**: The first round of public surveys on [Speak Up Arvada](https://speakup.arvada.org/) were completed. Residents were able to share their preferences for playground themes and equipment.
- **Fall/Winter 2022**: The City team incorporated feedback into playground design options.
- **Early 2023**: Surveys on Speak Up Arvada were open from Feb. 6 through March 6 for the community to share their input on final design options.
- **Spring 2023**: The design team incorporated feedback received from the community to make a final design selection. For the Creekside Park playground renovation, the Wildlife Theme (Option 2 in the survey) designed by Altitude Recreation was selected.
- **Week of June 26**: Construction begins.
- **Week of August 14**: Renovation complete. Playground opened to the public.
